issue.title: sase monitor start --model accepts models the provider rejects; failure surfaces only after the starter is dead, with no inherited-model retry
issue.description: 'sase monitor start --model codex/gpt-5' (copied from the sase_monitor skill doc's example list) was accepted without validation; the follow-up agent then failed at launch with '400 ... The gpt-5 model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account' (sase-124.8.4.3.2--1, 2026-09-18 03:10 EDT). A bad model name cannot be fixed by retrying the same request but could be fixed by retrying once with the starter's inherited route (gpt-5.5@xhigh); no such retry exists, and the 03:12 'Wait dependency can never self-resolve' notification is passive. The sase-124 epic chain stalled for the rest of the night. Fix: validate --model against the provider's live catalog and account restrictions while the starter is alive; on a non-retryable launch failure relaunch once with the inherited model; remove codex/gpt-5 from the skill doc examples (use @small).

task_type_fields.impact: One bad string stalls an entire epic chain overnight; sase-124.8.4.3 is still open with its land waiter gone
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/monitor/start.py --model handling; src/sase/xprompts/skills sase_monitor doc --model examples
task_type_fields.repro: sase monitor start --model 'codex/gpt-5' on a ChatGPT-account codex host; starter dies, follow-up 400s at 03:10 EDT with no recovery (artifact ace-run 202609/18, family sase-124.8.4.3.2)
